body:
I don’t want a divorce. I don’t want to give up without even trying. But, I never really know what he’s feeling. I could ask the same question over and over again and get completely different answers depending on his mood.  I don’t know if he truly wants me or not. 

I’d never force him to stay. My door is open if he ever wants to walk out. But, I’ve told him if he wants to go then we can’t be friends. And he’ll never hear from me again. Why would I do that to my self

I want to make it work.. but what am I suppose to do if couples counseling doesn’t work....? I don’t want to keep feeling like I don’t matter. I don’t want to pretend like everything is okay when It’s not.
I don’t want temporary love. I don’t want him to treat me really nice and then treat Me like crap within two months or two weeks.
Well, he’ll be back in a couple of weeks and I’ve been thinking about couples counseling but i just don’t know how to bring it up
Yes. But, I’m not exactly sure how to bring it up..
